ZWE.note: RBZ sets fees and limits but the article does not state licensing, switch oversight or a regional link.

facts.fact: The RBZ directed all banks and deposit-taking microfinance institutions to cap cash withdrawal fees at 2% and POS charges at 1.5%, and to remove balance inquiry fees on banking and mobile banking platforms, by 31 March 2026.
The RBZ governor says the central bank has continued to receive complaints from the banking public about the high cost of banking.

ZWE.note: Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: The RBZ raised mobile money and ZIPIT transaction limits to ZiG13,000 per transaction from ZiG8,000, person to person or business, with a ZiG50,000 monthly cap.

ZWE.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment.
